svg.title: Opposite occupation changes carry current without adding carriers
svg.desc: Two equally weighted electron states have velocities minus v and plus v, with v positive. Both equilibrium occupations are 0.500. The perturbed occupations are f_minus=0.501 and f_plus=0.499. The signed bars show delta f divided by 0.001: plus one for the minus-v state and minus one for the plus-v state. The number weight remains one, but the velocity weight is minus 0.002v. Multiplying by electron charge minus e and the common positive state-counting weight gives a positive current contribution.
svg.text: An occupation imbalance carries current at fixed density
Electron charge −e reverses the sign: the pair carries a positive conventional current.
